about.text: Bosnian smoked cheese (also known as Suhi sir or Dimljeni sir) is a type of very dry piquant low-fat smoked cheese originating from Bosnia and Herzegovina. It is usually home-made product, but industrial production also exists.

sources.text: Raw milk of sheep, goat or cow or a mix; hard, dark skin, white interior, very dry and low-fat, smoked; mostly homemade; article gives no ageing time
